versions.name: Canyon Camp

features.note: A pool three to ten feet deep, also used for snorkelling.
The Coon Lake lakefront, with a fleet of watercraft.
A new COPE adventure facility with high and low ropes courses and a rappelling tower.
A multi-difficulty climbing wall and a twelve-sided continuous bouldering wall.
The COPE tower, used for rappelling.
Canvas tents on platforms with bunks and mattresses.
Operation O.W.L., the Outdoor Wilderness League, for older Scouts and leaders.

versions.summary: Blackhawk Area Council Scouts BSA resident summer camp near Galena and Stockton, Illinois, offering over 55 merit badges alongside specialty programs.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
